verdict.rationale: cubic documents a native integration that reads linked Linear or Jira issues and checks PRs against their requirements, so Jira-based context extension exists as the product's own capability. Nothing in the evidence shows Slack, Google Drive, or a general workflow-tool connector framework. missing for 10: Slack integration for context, Google Drive integration, a broader catalog of workflow-tool connectors, independent corroboration of the Jira integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: cubic can automatically analyze your pull requests to see if they meet the requirements from your linked Linear or Jira issues.
